title: Reconstruct, Practice, Go Real: Guided Self-Improvement for Embodied Agents
summary: Building reliable robot capabilities across diverse tasks requires substantial human effort to develop and maintain skills, design rewards, and integrate perception with control. We present Reconstruct, Practice, Go Real (RPG), a framework for autonomous improvement of robot execution systems without updating model weights. RPG identifies manipulation capabilities in an offline dataset and constructs related practice tasks in simulation. During practice, RPG uses execution feedback, privileged simulator state, and available dataset videos to diagnose failures. It develops new reusable symbolic skills, refines existing skills, and revises the system prompt based on these diagnoses. Cross-task evaluation tests individual candidate changes and merged revisions before they are retained for reuse. At test time, a multimodal LLM uses the resulting system prompt and skill library to coordinate perception and robot control. On held-out initializations of 22 manipulation tasks, RPG improves task success from 28.6% after the first practice round to 95.0% after 15 rounds, outperforming all evaluated baselines, including ASPIRE (75.5%) and CaP-Agent0 powered by GPT-6 Astra Pro (60.0%). After a common calibration and hardware-adaptation procedure, the frozen system succeeds in all 30 physical trials, with ten trials on each of three tasks. Project Website: https://rpg-robot.github.io/
tldr: RPG is a framework for autonomous improvement of robot execution systems without weight updates, using simulation practice and cross-task evaluation to refine symbolic skills and system prompts, achieving 95% success on 22 manipulation tasks and 30/30 real-world trials.
tldr_zh: RPG是一个无需更新模型权重即可自主改进机器人执行系统的框架，通过模拟练习和跨任务评估来优化符号技能和系统提示，在22个操作任务上达到95%的成功率，并在30次真实世界试验中全部成功。
summary_zh: 构建跨多样任务的可靠机器人能力需要大量人力来开发和维护技能、设计奖励函数，并将感知与控制系统相集成。我们提出了“重建、练习、实物运行”（RPG）框架，该框架能够在无需更新模型权重的情况下，实现机器人执行系统的自主改进。RPG从离线数据集中识别操作能力，并在仿真环境中构建相关的练习任务。在练习过程中，RPG利用执行反馈、特权仿真器状态以及可用的数据集视频来诊断失败原因。它开发新的可复用符号技能、优化现有技能，并根据这些诊断结果修订系统提示词。跨任务评估会在各项候选修改被保留复用之前，对单个候选修改及合并后的修订版本进行测试。在测试时，多模态大语言模型利用最终的系统提示词和技能库来协调感知与机器人控制。在22项操作任务的保留初始化测试中，RPG将任务成功率从首轮练习后的28.6%提升至15轮后的95.0%，优于所有评估的基线方法，包括ASPIRE（75.5%）和由GPT-6 Astra Pro驱动的CaP-Agent0（60.0%）。经过常规校准和硬件适配流程后，固定系统在全部30次实物试验中取得成功，涵盖三项任务各10次试验。项目网站：https://rpg-robot.github.io/

title: InterEvolve: Test-Time Evolution of Reward Programs for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: We study test-time evolution for humanoid loco-manipulation: solving tasks that a controller was never trained for by repurposing its existing skills, improving from its own attempts, and retaining what it learns, without retraining. Our key insight is that a broad controller already holds much of the competence a new task needs, and that this competence becomes accessible through an interface between planning and control that is expressive enough to specify contact-rich, multi-stage interactions, yet executable and measurable enough that execution feedback can guide planning from experience. InterEvolve realizes this interface with two components. First, we develop an object-aware forward-backward (FB) behavioral foundation model, whose object residuals on a frozen body prior turn a new reward about the body or objects into loco-manipulation behavior at test time. Second, we specify tasks as reward programs: staged rewards with completion conditions and tunable constants. A large language model (LLM) agent revises the program structure in context, drawing on execution feedback and a skill library of verified programs, while a numerical optimizer tunes its constants. With every candidate verified across parallel simulation scenarios, the program explores new ways to induce, repurpose, and compose the controller's existing motor competence for the task at hand, and thus improves over iterations. Experiments show that human-designed rewards leave much of the FB model's loco-manipulation competence untapped, whereas the programs InterEvolve evolves release it, sometimes through novel strategies. It further produces behaviors for diverse tasks, complex scenes, and long-horizon compositions in simulation, and evolved skills run autonomously on a physical Unitree G1 from egocentric onboard perception.
tldr: InterEvolve introduces test-time evolution of reward programs for humanoid loco-manipulation, combining an object-aware forward-backward behavioral foundation model with an LLM-driven program revision and numerical optimization to repurpose existing motor skills for novel tasks without retraining.
tldr_zh: InterEvolve 提出了一种用于人形机器人移动操控的测试时奖励程序演化方法，结合对象感知的前向-后向行为基础模型与LLM驱动的程序修订和数值优化，在不重新训练的情况下重用现有运动技能以解决新任务。
summary_zh: 我们研究了人形机器人移动操作中的测试时演化问题：通过重新利用控制器已有技能来解决其从未训练过的任务，从自身尝试中改进，并保留所学内容，而无需重新训练。我们的关键洞见是，一个广泛能力的控制器已经具备了新任务所需的许多能力，而通过一种介于规划与控制之间的接口，这些能力可以被访问——该接口需足够具有表现力以指定涉及接触的多阶段交互，同时又需足够可执行和可测量，从而使执行反馈能够引导基于经验的规划。InterEvolve通过两个组件实现了这一接口。首先，我们开发了一个对象感知的前向-后向（FB）行为基础模型，其基于冻结身体先验的对象残差能够在测试时将关于身体或对象的新奖励转化为移动操作行为。其次，我们将任务指定为奖励程序：包含完成条件和可调常量的分阶段奖励。一个大型语言模型（LLM）智能体在上下文中修订程序结构，利用执行反馈和经过验证的程序技能库，同时一个数值优化器调整其常量。每个候选方案都在并行仿真场景中得到验证，程序据此探索新的方式来诱导、重用并组合控制器现有的运动技能以完成当前任务，从而在迭代中不断改进。实验表明，人工设计的奖励未能充分发挥FB模型的移动操作能力，而InterEvolve演化出的程序则释放了这些能力，有时甚至通过新颖的策略实现。此外，该方法还能在仿真中为多样化任务、复杂场景和长时程组合生成行为，并且演化出的技能可在物理Unitree G1机器人上基于以自我为中心的机载感知自主运行。

title: UniWAM: Unified World-Action Model
summary: Vision-language-action models benefit from the understanding and reasoning capabilities of pretrained vision-language models, but action-only supervision provides limited grounding in world dynamics. Conversely, world-action models inherit spatiotemporal priors from video generation models, yet remain limited in semantic understanding and reasoning under distribution shifts. We introduce UniWAM, a unified architecture that integrates a physical reasoner, a world generator, and an action predictor to jointly learn semantic understanding of the physical world, visual generation, and action prediction. To ensure the quality of the training data, we developed a rigorous data cleaning and annotation pipeline for both human egocentric data and robot data. To adapt the vision-language component to embodied tasks while preserving its inherited language capabilities, we represent low-level actions in natural language and introduce a pre-training recipe that assigns complementary supervision from visual question answering (VQA) data, human egocentric data, and robot demonstrations to the appropriate model components. During post-training, future visual noise augmentation reduces reliance on precise future predictions, while history-conditioned flow matching uses encoded action history to initialize action generation. Together, these designs significantly reduce denoising steps while maintaining performance. UniWAM achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across multiple evaluations, including in-distribution performance, robustness, generalization, instruction following, and long-horizon task execution. Furthermore, we uncover a log-linear scaling law of unified human-robot co-training, demonstrating the effectiveness of large-scale pre-training on a mixture of human and robot data.
tldr: UniWAM unifies physical reasoning, video generation, and action prediction in a single model for embodied AI, achieving SOTA performance across various embodied tasks via joint human-robot pretraining and efficient post-training designs.
tldr_zh: UniWAM在单一模型中统一了物理推理、视频生成和动作预测，通过人机联合预训练和高效的后训练设计，在多种具身任务上取得了SOTA性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型受益于预训练视觉-语言模型的理解与推理能力，但仅依赖动作监督对其在世界动态方面的建模能力有限。相反，世界-动作模型继承了视频生成模型的时空先验，但在分布偏移下其语义理解与推理能力仍显不足。我们提出了UniWAM，一种统一架构，集成了物理推理器、世界生成器和动作预测器，以联合学习物理世界的语义理解、视觉生成和动作预测。为确保训练数据质量，我们为人类自我中心数据和机器人数据开发了严格的数据清洗与标注流程。为使视觉-语言组件适配具身任务同时保留其固有的语言能力，我们以自然语言表示底层动作，并提出了一种预训练方案，从视觉问答（VQA）数据、人类自我中心数据和机器人演示中为相应模型组件分配互补监督信号。在后训练阶段，未来视觉噪声增强降低了对精确未来预测的依赖，而基于历史条件的流匹配利用编码的动作历史初始化动作生成。这些设计共同显著减少了去噪步数，同时保持了性能。UniWAM在多项评估中均达到最先进（SOTA）水平，包括分布内性能、鲁棒性、泛化能力、指令跟随和长时程任务执行。此外，我们发现了统一人-机协同训练的对数线性缩放规律，证明了在大规模人类与机器人数据混合上进行预训练的有效性。

title: ActiveWAM: Evidence-Aware Active Vision for World-Action Models
summary: Active vision manipulation requires a policy to control both its camera and its end-effectors, yet camera motion determines which evidence remains visible within finite observation windows. Acquiring a new view can displace task-critical cues, while retaining a view forgoes potentially useful observations. We formulate this as an evidence-aware retain--acquire problem and present ActiveWAM, a unified world--action model that learns observation and manipulation jointly. To this end, we propose training-time inversion which constrains a frozen video prior by task-bearing source evidence and visible temporal changes, eliminating the need for test-time inversion or candidate ranking. At deployment, the policy generates bimanual and pan/tilt actions-including stay and reacquisition behaviors-from view-aware history, and updates context from newly measured RGB observations. Future-video prediction serves as a co-training signal, while action generation requires neither future-video decoding nor optimal viewpoint annotations. We introduce RoboTwin-AV, a 50-task benchmark with executable pan/tilt control and automatically generated demonstrations. ActiveWAM improves TAVIS out-of-distribution success by up to 17.0 percentage points over the strongest baselines, achieves 20.0 additional points over Fast-WAM on RoboTwin-AV, and outperforms it by 26.7 points on real-world physical kitchen tasks.
tldr: ActiveWAM introduces an evidence-aware active vision framework for world-action models, jointly learning camera and manipulation policies with a training-time inversion technique and a new benchmark, significantly improving task success in simulation and real-world kitchen tasks.
tldr_zh: ActiveWAM 提出了一种证据感知的主动视觉框架，用于世界-行动模型，通过训练时反转技术联合学习相机和操作策略，并引入新基准，在仿真和真实厨房任务中显著提升了任务成功率。
summary_zh: 主动视觉操作需要策略同时控制相机和末端执行器，然而相机运动决定了在有限观测窗口内哪些证据保持可见。获取新视角可能使任务关键线索移出视野，而保持当前视角则会错失潜在有用的观测信息。本文将这一问题建模为证据感知的保持-获取问题，并提出ActiveWAM——一个统一的世界-动作模型，联合学习观测与操作。为此，我们提出训练时反演方法，利用任务相关的源证据和可见的时间变化来约束冻结的视频先验，从而无需测试时反演或候选排序。在部署阶段，策略从视角感知的历史中生成双臂及云台俯仰动作（包括保持和重新获取行为），并根据新测量的RGB观测更新上下文。未来视频预测作为协同训练信号，而动作生成既不需要未来视频解码，也不需要最优视角标注。我们引入了RoboTwin-AV，一个包含50个任务的基准测试平台，具有可执行的云台俯仰控制及自动生成的演示数据。ActiveWAM在TAVIS分布外成功率上比最强基线提升了最高17.0个百分点，在RoboTwin-AV上比Fast-WAM高出20.0个百分点，并在真实世界物理厨房任务中比其领先26.7个百分点。

title: FutureWorlds: Learning Robotic World Models from Alternative Futures
summary: Robotic world models predict action-conditioned future scenes, providing a foundation for understanding action outcomes. However, turning alternative predictions into useful learning signals remains challenging: similar candidates limit informative quality comparisons, while diverging trajectories require persistent maintenance of their individual histories. We introduce FutureWorlds, a framework that unifies candidate construction, history maintenance, and learning from relative quality. Built on a multimodal discrete autoregressive model, FutureWorlds uses diverse beam search during reinforcement learning to construct candidate futures that balance confidence and diversity. Candidate-specific bounded memory preserves scene states and ensures that generation and policy scoring use matching histories. We further propose MemSPO (Memory-Conditioned Search-Guided Policy Optimization), which converts video trajectory rewards into group-relative advantages to optimize the world model. On RT-1, BridgeV2, and RoboCasa, FutureWorlds reduces LPIPS for 32-frame predictions by 14.78%, 20.84%, and 9.12%, respectively, relative to the strongest baseline on each dataset. Under fixed evaluation configurations, only 200 MemSPO updates further improve generation quality and support continued prediction beyond the training horizon. Memory ablations, decoding sensitivity analysis, and optical-flow evaluation show that these gains extend beyond visual quality to more accurate motion prediction and more consistent object states. Project page and code: https://github.com/Alexander-wu/FutureWorlds.
tldr: FutureWorlds introduces a framework for learning robotic world models from alternative action-conditioned future predictions, using diverse beam search and candidate-specific memory with a novel policy optimization (MemSPO) to improve generation quality and motion prediction on multiple robot datasets.
tldr_zh: FutureWorlds 提出了一种从多样化动作条件未来预测中学习机器人世界模型的框架，利用多样束搜索和候选特定记忆以及新的策略优化（MemSPO），在多个机器人数据集上提高了生成质量和运动预测精度。
summary_zh: 机器人世界模型预测动作条件下的未来场景，为理解动作结果提供了基础。然而，将替代性预测转化为有用的学习信号仍具挑战：相似候选者限制了信息量丰富的质量比较，而发散轨迹则需要持续维护各自的独立历史。我们提出FutureWorlds，一个统一候选构建、历史维护和基于相对质量学习的框架。基于多模态离散自回归模型，FutureWorlds在强化学习过程中使用多样化束搜索来构建兼具置信度与多样性的候选未来。候选特定的有界记忆保留场景状态，确保生成与策略评分使用匹配的历史。我们进一步提出MemSPO（记忆条件搜索引导策略优化），将视频轨迹奖励转化为组内相对优势以优化世界模型。在RT-1、BridgeV2和RoboCasa上，相较各数据集最强基线，FutureWorlds将32帧预测的LPIPS分别降低14.78%、20.84%和9.12%。在固定评测配置下，仅需200次MemSPO更新即可进一步提升生成质量，并支持超出训练时域长度的持续预测。记忆消融、解码敏感性分析及光流评估表明，这些提升不仅限于视觉质量，还扩展到更准确的运动预测和更一致的物体状态。项目页面及代码：https://github.com/Alexander-wu/FutureWorlds。

title: Divide-and-Remember: Recursive Action-Relevant Memory for Long-Horizon VLA Policies
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models struggle on history-dependent manipulation tasks, where the current observation alone does not determine the action, and the policy needs a memory of the history. Existing memory methods decide what to remember by design, for example, keeping frames with large pixel changes, and show inconsistent gains across tasks. We view what to remember as an optimisation problem. From the POMDP formulation of imitation learning, we show that the optimal memory maximises the conditional mutual information $I(a_t; m_t \mid o_t)$ between the action and the memory given the current observation. Intuitively, this means preserving the action-relevant information in the history that is not already contained in the current observation. Based on our analysis, we propose Divide-and-Remember (D&R), a recursive memory method that learns a memory function $m_t = M(h_t)$ and scales to long contexts while staying compute-light. It involves two strategies: (1) the selection over the full history is divided recursively into subproblems of top-$K$ selection over $2K$ tokens, so that fixed-size, lightweight selectors learned end-to-end support an unbounded history; (2) all recursion blocks share one selector, which captures the selection rule common to every block and keeps the method efficient. On RoboMME, a benchmark of 16 long-horizon manipulation tasks that require remembering when, where, what, and how to act, D&R achieves a state-of-the-art average success rate with consistent gains across all four suites under a budget of only 64 tokens; real-robot experiments show the same gain. Code, checkpoints and more results are at https://dnr-memory.github.io/
tldr: This paper introduces Divide-and-Remember (D&R), a recursive memory method for VLA policies that optimizes action-relevant information retention, achieving state-of-the-art performance on long-horizon manipulation tasks and real-robot experiments with a compact memory budget.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了 Divide-and-Remember (D&R)，一种用于 VLA 策略的递归记忆方法，通过优化与动作相关的信息保留，在长时程操作任务和真实机器人实验中以紧凑的记忆预算取得了最优性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在依赖历史信息的操控任务中表现不佳，这类任务中仅凭当前观测无法确定动作，策略需要记忆历史信息。现有记忆方法通过设计决定记忆内容，例如保留像素变化较大的帧，但在不同任务上的提升效果并不一致。我们将“记忆什么”视为一个优化问题。基于模仿学习的POMDP框架，我们证明了最优记忆应最大化给定当前观测条件下动作与记忆之间的条件互信息$I(a_t; m_t \mid o_t)$。直观上，这意味着保留历史中与动作相关且当前观测尚未包含的信息。基于上述分析，我们提出了Divide-and-Remember（D&R）方法，一种递归记忆方法，学习记忆函数$m_t = M(h_t)$，能够扩展到长上下文同时保持计算轻量。该方法包含两种策略：（1）将全历史的选择递归划分为对$2K$个token进行top-$K$选择的子问题，从而以固定大小、轻量的端到端学习选择器支持无界历史；（2）所有递归块共享一个选择器，捕获各块共同的选择规则，保持方法高效。在RoboMME基准上——该基准包含16个需要记住何时、何地、什么以及如何行动的长时程操控任务——D&R在仅64个token的预算下取得了最先进的平均成功率，并在全部四个套件中实现一致提升；真实机器人实验也验证了同样的提升。代码、检查点及更多结果见https://dnr-memory.github.io/。

title: eRLT: Efficient VLA Reinforcement Learning via Action-Relevant Token Routing
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide strong behavioral priors for robotic manipulation, yet efficiently adapting them to downstream tasks remains challenging. Recent work addresses this challenge by adapting frozen VLAs through online reinforcement learning (RL), whose sample efficiency depends on the quality of the state representation used by the actor and critic. Existing methods construct such representations either with VLA-independent visual encoders or through fixed compression of internal VLA representations. Neither design explicitly extracts the task-specific action-relevant VLA features most useful for downstream action refinement and action-value estimation, therefore limiting sample efficiency. To address this limitation, we introduce eRLT, which constructs an effective state representation by routing task-specific action-relevant information across both tokens and layers of the frozen VLA. Specifically, learned routing tokens dynamically aggregate visual-language features at multiple depths, while a lightweight layer router combines these summaries into a fixed-dimensional RL token. The routing module is initialized using expert demonstrations to capture features predictive of expert actions and then refined using critic feedback from online interactions for action-value estimation. Across seven LIBERO and RoboTwin tasks, eRLT improves mean normalized learning-curve AUC by up to 23.7% over representative baselines. Real-robot experiments on USB connector insertion and motherboard ribbon-cable insertion further show AUC improvements of 108.9% and 46.7%, respectively, over the strongest baseline.
tldr: eRLT improves sample efficiency of online RL fine-tuning for frozen VLA models by routing task-specific action-relevant information across tokens and layers, validated on simulated and real robot manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: eRLT通过对冻结的VLA模型进行跨token和层的路由，提取任务相关的动作特征，提升了在线强化学习微调的样本效率，并在仿真和真实机器人操作任务中进行了验证。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为机器人操作提供了强大的行为先验，但如何高效地将它们适配到下游任务仍然是一个挑战。近期研究通过在线强化学习（RL）适配冻结的VLA模型来应对这一挑战，其样本效率取决于演员和评论家所使用的状态表示质量。现有方法要么使用与VLA无关的视觉编码器，要么通过对VLA内部表示进行固定压缩来构建此类表示，但两者均未明确提取对下游动作细化和动作价值估计最有用的任务特定动作相关VLA特征，从而限制了样本效率。为解决这一问题，我们提出了eRLT，通过在冻结VLA的令牌和层之间路由任务特定的动作相关信息来构建有效的状态表示。具体而言，学习得到的路由令牌在多个深度动态聚合视觉-语言特征，而轻量级的层路由器将这些摘要组合成固定维度的RL令牌。路由模块利用专家示范进行初始化，以捕获可预测专家动作的特征，随后利用在线交互中的评论家反馈进行细化，以用于动作价值估计。在七个LIBERO和RoboTwin任务中，eRLT相较于代表性基线，将平均归一化学习曲线AUC提升了最高23.7%。在USB连接器插入和主板排线插入的真实机器人实验中，相较于最强基线，AUC分别提升了108.9%和46.7%。

title: UniTrackPLA: Unified Panorama-Language-Action Model for Instruction-Guided Navigation and Dynamic Person Tracking
summary: General-purpose embodied robots should support both navigation toward language-specified destinations and dynamic person tracking under arbitrary initial target azimuths. However, existing methods typically rely on forward-facing observations and address these tasks with separate policies, limiting omnidirectional perception and unified closed-loop control. We present UniTrackPLA, a unified panorama-language-action model for instruction-guided navigation and dynamic person tracking. Its Panoramic-Aware Encoding (PAE) preserves the temporal and azimuthal structure of perspective views projected from each panorama, enabling perspective-pretrained visual encoders to process omnidirectional observations. A shared vision-language backbone grounds instructions in the panoramic context and predicts continuous robot-centric waypoint chunks for both tasks. World-Action Consistency (WAC) further predicts action-conditioned future visual states and verifies waypoint prefixes online, allowing reliable actions to be reused while triggering replanning upon inconsistency. We also introduce OmniTrackNav-Bench, comprising 5,000 simulated tracking trajectories, 10,000 simulated VLN routes, and 96 verified real-world routes, providing 919,978 waypoint-supervision instances. UniTrackPLA improves overall tracking SR from 23.50% to 35.00% and Omni-VLN SR/SPL from 13.00%/12.77% to 19.75%/19.29%. Incorporating 76 real-world routes further improves held-out EP@0.2m from 42.92% to 92.08%. Closed-loop experiments on a Go2-W robot demonstrate unified panoramic tracking and navigation across indoor and outdoor environments. The project page is at https://tw5775.github.io/UniTrackPLA.
tldr: UniTrackPLA introduces a unified panorama-language-action model for instruction-guided navigation and dynamic person tracking, using panoramic-aware encoding and world-action consistency to enable closed-loop control on a real robot, with new benchmarks and significant performance gains.
tldr_zh: UniTrackPLA 提出了一种统一的全景-语言-动作模型，用于指令引导导航和动态人员跟踪，通过全景感知编码和世界-动作一致性实现真实机器人上的闭环控制，并提供了新基准和显著性能提升。
summary_zh: 通用型具身机器人应支持朝向语言指定目的地的导航，以及在任意初始目标方位角下的动态人员跟踪。然而，现有方法通常依赖前向观测，并以独立策略处理这些任务，限制了全景感知与统一闭环控制的实现。我们提出UniTrackPLA，一个统一的“全景-语言-动作”模型，用于指令引导导航与动态人员跟踪。其全景感知编码（PAE）保留了从每张全景图投影出的透视视图的时间与方位角结构，使预训练的透视视觉编码器能够处理全方位观测。共享的视觉-语言骨干网络将指令嵌入全景上下文中，并为两个任务预测连续的机器人中心航点序列。世界-动作一致性（WAC）进一步预测基于动作的未来视觉状态，并在线验证航点前缀，使可靠的动作可被复用，同时在不一致时触发重新规划。我们还引入了OmniTrackNav-Bench，包含5,000条模拟跟踪轨迹、10,000条模拟VLN路线和96条经验证的真实世界路线，共提供919,978个航点监督实例。UniTrackPLA将整体跟踪成功率从23.50%提升至35.00%，将Omni-VLN的SR/SPL从13.00%/12.77%提升至19.75%/19.29%。整合76条真实世界路线进一步将留出集EP@0.2m从42.92%提升至92.08%。在Go2-W机器人上的闭环实验展示了在室内外环境中统一的全景跟踪与导航能力。项目页面见https://tw5775.github.io/UniTrackPLA。

title: ECoMEM: Explicit Concept Memory for Memory-Dependent Robot Control
summary: A robot may lose sight of an object it must later retrieve, need to recall what a person demonstrated earlier, or track which steps of a task it has already completed. Current vision-language-action (VLA) policies often fail once the information needed for action disappears from the current observation, making memory critical for long-horizon robot behavior. Existing approaches typically provide longer histories or learn implicit memory from observation-action trajectories. But action supervision tells a policy how to act, not what to remember: it does not specify which past facts should persist or how they should change as new evidence arrives. We therefore separate maintaining an evidence-grounded account of the past from learning how to act on it. This insight motivates Explicit Concept Memory (ECoMEM), which represents task-relevant history with a reusable library of grounded concepts. An evidence-based Writer selects and updates these records, while a learned Reader turns them into memory tokens that directly condition the VLA. Across 16 RoboMME tasks, ECoMEM leads the evaluated robot policies on 15 tasks. On two new real-robot tasks, the same memory library either transfers directly or requires only one new concept, achieving 86.1% success versus 8.6% for a no-memory VLA. These results show that explicit concepts provide a reusable and extensible memory interface for robot control. Project website: https://ecomem.github.io/
tldr: ECoMEM introduces an explicit, evidence-grounded concept memory library for VLA policies, separating memory maintenance from action learning to improve long-horizon robot control, achieving state-of-the-art results on 15/16 RoboMME tasks and 86.1% success on new real-robot tasks.
tldr_zh: ECoMEM 为 VLA 策略引入了一个基于证据的显式概念记忆库，将记忆维护与动作学习分离，从而提升长期机器人控制性能，在 16 个 RoboMME 任务中的 15 个上达到最佳，并在新的真实机器人任务上取得 86.1% 的成功率。
summary_zh: 机器人可能会丢失其稍后需要取回的物体的视线，需要回忆之前人类演示过的内容，或者追踪其已完成任务的步骤。当前的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在行动所需信息从当前观测中消失时常常失效，这使得记忆对于长时程机器人行为至关重要。现有方法通常提供更长的历史记录，或从观测-动作轨迹中学习隐式记忆。但动作监督告诉策略如何行动，而非记住什么：它并未指定哪些过去的事实应持续保留，以及随着新证据的到来它们应如何更新。因此，我们将维护以证据为基础的历史记录与学习如何基于历史行动分开处理。这一见解催生了显式概念记忆（ECoMEM），它通过一个可复用的基础概念库来表示与任务相关的历史。一个基于证据的写入器选择并更新这些记录，而一个学习得到的读取器将它们转化为直接条件化VLA的记忆标记。在16项RoboMME任务中，ECoMEM在15项任务上超越了所评估的机器人策略。在两个新的真实机器人任务中，相同的记忆库要么直接迁移，要么仅需一个新增概念，实现了86.1%的成功率，而无记忆VLA仅为8.6%。这些结果表明，显式概念为机器人控制提供了一个可复用且可扩展的记忆接口。项目网站：https://ecomem.github.io/

title: Same Scene, Different Task: Skill Alignment for Compositional Generalization in VLAs
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models often struggle to generalize to skill combinations absent from their fine-tuning demonstrations, even when every constituent skill has been demonstrated. We focus on a vision shortcut as one failure mode: during fine-tuning, visual observations can serve as a proxy for the instruction, so a policy may execute a demonstrated combination associated with similar observations rather than the instructed combination. This motivates training with counterfactual pairs formed by holding a demonstration observation fixed while changing the instruction to specify an undemonstrated combination. These pairs, however, lack corresponding demonstrated action targets. Crucially, the currently required skill has already been demonstrated, but actions from those executions cannot serve as direct targets because the same skill can require different actions across observations. We propose CRAFT, which transfers supervision from demonstrated executions of the required skill to counterfactual pairs using skill representations that can be reused across executions of the same skill. Across three VLA models and two simulation benchmarks, CRAFT improves success on undemonstrated combinations while maintaining high success on demonstrated ones; it also improves compositional generalization on a real robot. Project website: https://taegeunyang.github.io/craft/
tldr: CRAFT addresses compositional generalization in VLA models by using skill representations to align supervision from demonstrated skill executions to counterfactual observation-instruction pairs, improving performance on undemonstrated skill combinations in simulation and real robots.
tldr_zh: CRAFT通过使用技能表示将已演示技能的执行监督对齐到反事实的观察-指令对，解决了VLA模型在组合泛化上的问题，在仿真和真实机器人上提升了未演示技能组合的性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在泛化到微调演示中未出现的技能组合时常常遇到困难，即便每个组成技能都已被演示过。我们关注一种失败模式——视觉捷径：在微调过程中，视觉观察可以作为指令的代理，因此策略可能执行与相似观察相关联的已演示组合，而非所指示的组合。这促使我们使用反事实配对进行训练，即保持演示观察不变，同时将指令改为指定一种未被演示的组合。然而，这些配对缺乏相应的已演示动作目标。关键在于，当前所需技能已被演示过，但这些执行中的动作不能直接作为目标，因为同一技能在不同观察下可能需要不同的动作。我们提出CRAFT方法，利用可在同一技能的多次执行中复用的技能表示，将所需技能的已演示执行中的监督信号迁移至反事实配对。在三种VLA模型和两个仿真基准上，CRAFT在未演示组合上提升了成功率，同时保持已演示组合的高成功率；它还在真实机器人上提升了组合泛化能力。项目网站：https://taegeunyang.github.io/craft/

title: ATI-VLA: Action-Centric Predictive Vision-Language-Action Models via Actionable Alignment Then Adaptive Injection
summary: Predictive Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models aim to improve robotic manipulation via future observation or world dynamics forecasting. However, existing approaches often fail to realize this potential and underperform direct action prediction models. We argue that these limitations stem from modality misalignment between observations and actions, together with joint optimization conflicts that drive learning away from an action-centric objective. To this end, we introduce ATI-VLA, an Action-Centric Predictive Vision-Language-Action framework via Actionable Alignment Then Adaptive Injection. Specifically, it follows a two-step design: 1) Actionable Representation Alignment via a Shared Codebook. It aligns predictive observation and action representations by mapping both modalities into a shared discrete latent space via a unified codebook, making predictive observation latents readily usable for action generation and mitigating modality misalignment. 2) Action-Centric Adaptive Injection of Predictive Latents. Building upon this, it then injects predictive observation latents into action decoding as explicit predictive priors via a lightweight adaptive side-path, enabling adaptive predictive guidance under a single action-centric objective. Extensive experiments on both simulation and real-world robotic tasks demonstrate that ATI-VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance with faster convergence.
tldr: ATI-VLA introduces an action-centric predictive VLA framework that aligns observation and action representations via a shared codebook and injects predictive latents as explicit priors through an adaptive side-path, achieving state-of-the-art robotic manipulation performance with faster convergence.
tldr_zh: ATI-VLA 提出了一种以动作为中心的预测性视觉-语言-动作模型框架，通过共享码本对齐观测与动作表示，并通过自适应侧路径注入预测潜变量作为显式先验，在机器人操作任务中实现了最先进的性能和更快的收敛。
summary_zh: 预测性视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型旨在通过未来观测或世界动态预测来提升机器人操作能力。然而，现有方法往往未能实现这一潜力，其性能甚至不如直接的动作预测模型。我们认为，这些局限性源于观测与动作之间的模态不对齐，以及联合优化冲突导致学习偏离以动作为中心的优化目标。为此，我们提出ATI-VLA，一种通过可操作对齐后自适应注入实现的动作中心预测性视觉-语言-动作框架。具体而言，该框架采用两步设计：1）通过共享码本实现可操作表示对齐。该方法通过统一码本将预测性观测和动作表示映射到共享的离散潜空间中，使预测性观测潜变量可直接用于动作生成，从而缓解模态不对齐问题。2）预测性潜变量的动作中心自适应注入。在此基础上，该方法通过轻量级自适应旁路将预测性观测潜变量作为显式预测先验注入动作解码过程，在单一动作中心目标下实现自适应预测引导。在仿真和真实机器人任务上的大量实验表明，ATI-VLA以更快的收敛速度取得了最先进的性能。

title: DuoMind: Enabling Distributed Multi-Robot Coordination with Semantic Communication
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) and vision-language-action models (VLAs) have recently driven rapid progress in general-purpose robots, yet most progress has focused on single-robot settings. Extending these capabilities to multi-robot systems remains challenging because robots must coordinate long-horizon behaviors while maintaining reliable, fine-grained execution. We introduce DuoMind, a distributed hierarchical framework for multi-robot coordination through semantic communication. Each robot uses a VLA-based action model for low-level execution and a VLM-based orchestrator for high-level reasoning and inter-agent coordination. At each planning step, the orchestrator at each robot reasons over the task instruction, local observations, and messages received from other robots. It then generates low-level instructions for the action model and semantic messages for peer robots. This architecture exploits the complementary strengths of pretrained models by combining the semantic reasoning capabilities of VLMs with the precise action-generation capabilities of VLAs. To address the scarcity of benchmarks for multi-robot coordination, we further develop RoboPoly, a benchmark comprising long-horizon manipulation tasks that require coordinated, closed-loop execution under distributed control. Experiments on RoboPoly and RoboTwin demonstrate that DuoMind improves multi-robot task performance, while ablation studies confirm the contributions of hierarchical orchestration and semantic communication. More details are available on our project page.
tldr: DuoMind introduces a distributed hierarchical framework that combines VLMs and VLAs with semantic communication to enable multi-robot coordination, along with a new benchmark, RoboPoly, for long-horizon multi-robot manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: DuoMind提出了一种结合VLM和VLA以及语义通信的分布式分层框架，用于多机器人协调，并引入了一个新的基准RoboPoly，用于长期多机器人操作任务。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）和视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）近期推动了通用机器人的快速发展，但大多数进展集中于单机器人场景。将这些能力扩展到多机器人系统仍然具有挑战性，因为机器人必须在保持可靠、细粒度执行的同时协调长期行为。我们提出了DuoMind，一种通过语义通信实现多机器人协调的分布式分层框架。每个机器人使用基于VLA的动作模型进行底层执行，并使用基于VLM的编排器进行高层推理和智能体间协调。在每个规划步骤中，各机器人的编排器对任务指令、局部观测以及从其他机器人接收到的消息进行推理，然后为动作模型生成底层指令，并为对等机器人生成语义消息。该架构通过结合VLM的语义推理能力与VLA的精确动作生成能力，充分发挥了预训练模型的互补优势。为解决多机器人协调基准稀缺的问题，我们进一步开发了RoboPoly，一个包含需要分布式控制下协调闭环执行的长期操作任务的基准。在RoboPoly和RoboTwin上的实验表明，DuoMind提升了多机器人任务性能，而消融研究证实了分层编排和语义通信的贡献。更多详情可见我们的项目页面。

title: SkeleWAM: Skeleton World-Action Modeling for Efficient Robotic Manipulation
summary: World action models (WAMs) combine robot action generation with future state prediction. Existing WAMs typically predict videos or learned visual latents, which represent interaction geometry only implicitly and may retain appearance information unrelated to control. We introduce SkeleWAM, a compact WAM that represents a manipulation scene as a sparse 3D skeleton composed of robot joints, object centers, and interaction points. Constructed online from current RGB-D observations and robot proprioception, the skeleton provides a unified geometric state for action generation and future skeleton prediction. Future skeleton prediction provides additional geometric supervision for action learning without requiring visual reconstruction. At inference, SkeleWAM generates actions directly from the current skeleton and language instruction, while Medoid Action Consensus (MAC) serves as an auxiliary consensus strategy for stochastic action samples. On LIBERO-Plus, SkeleWAM achieves an overall success rate of 85.9% with 57.1M parameters, outperforming Cosmos-Policy by 3.7 percentage points. These results demonstrate that sparse 3D robot--object structure provides an effective state space for robust and parameter-efficient world action learning. The project is available at https://skelewam-project.github.io/.
tldr: SkeleWAM introduces a skeleton-based world action model for robotic manipulation, representing scenes as sparse 3D skeletons of robot joints and object centers to enable efficient action generation and future state prediction, achieving high success on LIBERO-Plus with a compact model.
tldr_zh: SkeleWAM提出了一种基于骨架的世界动作模型，将操作场景表示为机器人关节和物体中心的稀疏3D骨架，从而高效生成动作并预测未来状态，在LIBERO-Plus上以紧凑模型取得了高成功率。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）将机器人动作生成与未来状态预测相结合。现有WAM通常预测视频或学习得到的视觉潜在表示，这些表示仅隐式地编码交互几何信息，并可能保留与控制无关的外观信息。我们提出SkeleWAM，一种紧凑的WAM，将操作场景表示为由机器人关节、物体中心和交互点组成的稀疏三维骨架。该骨架基于当前RGB-D观测和机器人本体感觉在线构建，为动作生成和未来骨架预测提供统一的几何状态表示。未来骨架预测为动作学习提供额外的几何监督，而无需进行视觉重建。在推理阶段，SkeleWAM直接从当前骨架和语言指令生成动作，同时Medoid动作共识（MAC）作为随机动作样本的辅助共识策略。在LIBERO-Plus基准上，SkeleWAM以57.1M参数实现了85.9%的总体成功率，比Cosmos-Policy高出3.7个百分点。这些结果表明，稀疏的三维机器人-物体结构为鲁棒且参数高效的世界动作学习提供了有效的状态空间。项目地址：https://skelewam-project.github.io/。

title: GlassGuard: Verified Glass Plane Mapping for Robot Navigation
summary: Transparent and specular surfaces pose a serious challenge to LiDAR-based SLAM and navigation because laser returns may pass through glass, leaving collision boundaries absent from the map. Prior work attempts to reconstruct the missing surfaces, but inaccurate obstacle placement can create the opposite failure: contamination of traversable free space. Recognizing this dual requirement, we present GlassGuard, a navigation-oriented framework for reconstructing planar architectural glass from complementary visual and LiDAR evidence. We formulate success in terms of both glass coverage and free-space contamination and apply this principle throughout proposal verification and global map construction. A foundation vision model provides glass-instance masks, structural 3D cues generate metric plane hypotheses, and depth-free 2D projective geometry checks their orientations before they enter a consolidated global map. We evaluate GlassGuard in nine building-scale scenes spanning diverse glass structures, spatial scales, and lighting conditions, with more than one hour and 2.1 km of real-world robot traversal. GlassGuard achieves 85% of total glass coverage for its panoramic version. Under identical pinhole inputs, GlassGuard achieves 82% total coverage, compared with at most 61% for the evaluated baselines, while producing 5-17x fewer false voxels per frame. Qualitative examples with a navigation planner illustrate the reconstructed planes blocking paths through glass while leaving traversable routes open. The project page is available at https://glassguardproject.github.io/.
tldr: GlassGuard reconstructs planar architectural glass for robot navigation by combining foundation vision model masks with geometric plane verification, achieving high glass coverage with low free-space contamination in real-world building-scale scenes.
tldr_zh: GlassGuard结合基础视觉模型掩码和几何平面验证，为机器人导航重建平面建筑玻璃，在真实建筑级场景中实现高玻璃覆盖率与低自由空间污染。
summary_zh: 透明和镜面表面对基于激光雷达的SLAM与导航构成了严峻挑战，因为激光返回信号可能穿过玻璃，导致地图中缺失碰撞边界。先前的工作尝试重建缺失的表面，但不准确的障碍物定位可能引发相反的问题：污染可通行的自由空间。认识到这一双重需求，我们提出了GlassGuard，一种面向导航的框架，利用视觉与激光雷达互补证据来重建平面建筑玻璃。我们从玻璃覆盖率和自由空间污染两方面来定义成功标准，并将这一原则贯穿于提案验证和全局地图构建的全过程。基础视觉模型提供玻璃实例掩码，结构三维线索生成度量平面假设，无深度的二维投影几何在平面假设进入整合的全局地图之前校验其方向。我们在九个涵盖多样玻璃结构、空间尺度和光照条件的建筑级场景中评估了GlassGuard，涉及超过一小时和2.1公里的真实机器人遍历。GlassGuard的全景版本实现了85%的总玻璃覆盖率。在相同的针孔输入条件下，GlassGuard实现了82%的总覆盖率，而评估的基线方法最高仅为61%，同时每帧产生的虚假体素数量减少了5至17倍。与导航规划器结合的定性示例表明，重建的平面能够阻挡穿过玻璃的路径，同时保持可通行路线畅通。项目页面可在https://glassguardproject.github.io/ 访问。

title: HumanoidToolBench: Benchmarking Humanoid Tool Use from Selection to Mobile Execution
summary: As robotic hardware and learning methods advance, humanoids need tools to perform tasks beyond their inherent physical limits. Successful tool use requires selecting a suitable tool and coordinating manipulation and, when needed, locomotion to complete the task. Existing benchmarks do not jointly evaluate these capabilities on a humanoid. We introduce HumanoidToolBench, an 18-task benchmark spanning three scenarios, three execution levels, and two tool-set modes, together with ToolBook, a dataset of 3.1k demonstrations collected in simulation and on a real Unitree G1. Evaluation of seven policies in simulation and three on the real robot reveals substantial gaps between selecting a suitable tool and completing the task. Focused GR00T N1.7 probes show reduced selection accuracy on unseen tools and continued task execution under unrelated instructions. Code and data are available at https://snu-pi.github.io/HumanoidToolBench/.
tldr: HumanoidToolBench is a benchmark with 18 tasks for evaluating humanoid robots' tool use from selection to mobile execution, including a dataset of 3.1k demonstrations and evaluations on simulated and real robot policies.
tldr_zh: HumanoidToolBench是一个包含18个任务的基准，用于评估人形机器人从工具选择到移动执行的能力，包括3100个示范的数据集以及在仿真和真实机器人上的策略评估。
summary_zh: 随着机器人硬件与学习方法不断进步，人形机器人需要借助工具来执行超出其自身物理能力的任务。成功的工具使用要求机器人能够选择合适的工具，并协调操控动作，必要时还需结合移动能力，以完成任务。现有基准测试未能同时评估人形机器人在这些方面的综合能力。为此，我们提出了HumanoidToolBench——一个包含18项任务的基准测试，涵盖三种场景、三个执行层级以及两种工具集模式；同时，我们构建了ToolBook数据集，其中包含在仿真环境和真实Unitree G1机器人上采集的3100条演示数据。我们在仿真环境中评估了七种策略，并在真实机器人上评估了三种策略，结果显示，从选择合适工具到最终完成任务之间仍存在显著差距。针对GR00T N1.7的聚焦探测实验表明，面对未见过的工具时其选择准确率有所下降，并在接收到无关指令时仍会继续执行任务。代码和数据可在 https://snu-pi.github.io/HumanoidToolBench/ 获取。

title: Robot Learning on Discrete Surfaces: Theory and Applications
summary: All the objects composing our world are enclosed within surfaces. Yet, most robot learning and motion generation frameworks treat surfaces as constraints ignoring their intrinsic geometry. This gap is acute for polyhedral meshes--the standard output of CAD and 3D reconstruction--whose discrete geometric structure remains unexploited. In this paper, we propose a unified discrete Riemannian framework that enables robot learning directly on polyhedral surface meshes. Using discrete differential geometry, we define logarithmic and exponential maps, parallel transport, and ambient-space projections that remain well-defined across faces, edges, and vertices. We instantiate the framework in three learning paradigms: (i) Dynamic Movement Primitives (DMPs), an improved exponential-map computation and a fixed-tangent-cone forcing-term encoding with parallel transport yield better cross-surface generalisation and stability over prior mesh-based approaches. (ii) Gaussian Process (GP), a geodesic-based kernel with practical admissibility control, enables regression at arbitrary mesh locations without smoothness assumptions. (iii) Riemannian Flow Matching (RFM), mesh-native operators improve generative quality over spectral baselines while reducing training time. The framework is validated in simulation against state-of-the-art methods and demonstrated on two real-robot scenarios: generalising user-drawn trajectories across different surfaces and planning polishing motions on RGB-D-reconstructed surfaces.
tldr: This paper presents a discrete Riemannian framework for robot learning on polyhedral surface meshes, enabling DMPs, Gaussian processes, and Riemannian Flow Matching with improved generalization and real-robot demonstrations in trajectory generalization and polishing.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个离散黎曼框架，用于在多面体表面网格上进行机器人学习，支持动态运动基元、高斯过程和黎曼流匹配，并在真实机器人上展示了轨迹泛化和抛光规划的应用。
summary_zh: 构成我们世界的所有物体都被表面所包围。然而，大多数机器人学习与运动生成框架将表面视为约束条件，而忽略了其内在几何结构。这一不足对于多面体网格——CAD和三维重建的标准输出——尤为突出，其离散几何结构尚未被充分利用。本文提出一个统一的离散黎曼框架，使机器人能够直接在多面体表面网格上进行学习。借助离散微分几何，我们定义了对数映射与指数映射、平行移动以及环境空间投影，这些操作在面、边和顶点上均保持良好定义。我们在三种学习范式中实例化了该框架：（i）动态运动原语（DMPs），通过改进的指数映射计算和基于固定切锥的强迫项编码结合平行移动，相较于先前的网格方法实现了更好的跨表面泛化性和稳定性。（ii）高斯过程（GP），基于测地线的核函数并具有实用的可容许性控制，能够在无需平滑性假设的情况下在网格任意位置进行回归。（iii）黎曼流匹配（RFM），网格原生算子相较于谱基线提升了生成质量，同时缩短了训练时间。该框架在仿真中与最新方法进行了对比验证，并在两个真实机器人场景中进行了演示：跨不同表面泛化用户绘制的轨迹，以及在RGB-D重建表面上规划抛光运动。

title: Continuous Conditioning of VLAs with Augmenting EMG and Visual Task Descriptors
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models rely strongly on language for describing task information, despite having multimodal inputs. We hypothesize that other modalities in the state space may present opportunities for supplemental task conditioning, which may be particularly relevant in cluttered or otherwise ambiguous scenes. We introduce two tuned models to test this hypothesis: (1) an electrophysiology-conditioned VLA (EC-VLA) that incorporates 8-channel electromyography envelopes as continuous conditioning input concatenated to the proprioceptive vector, and (2) a visually-annotated VLA (VA-VLA) that incorporates visual segmentation annotations to the image inputs. On a cube-selection task evaluated across three participants, EC-VLA matches a language-prompted baseline in uncluttered, in-distribution conditions and substantially outperforms it in cluttered, out-of-distribution scenes. Similarly, VA-VLA shows modest improvements over a language-prompted baseline in in-distribution scenes with substantial improvement in cluttered, out-of-distribution trials. Together, these results provide strong evidence for the potential benefit of task-conditioning beyond language.
tldr: This paper augments Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models with continuous EMG and visual segmentation task descriptors, showing improved performance in cluttered, out-of-distribution scenes compared to language-only conditioning.
tldr_zh: 本文通过在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中引入连续肌电信号和视觉分割任务描述符，在杂乱和分布外场景中相比纯语言条件提示取得了更优性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型虽然具备多模态输入，但在描述任务信息时高度依赖语言。我们假设状态空间中的其他模态可能为补充性任务条件设置提供机会，这在杂乱或存在歧义的场景中可能尤为重要。为验证这一假设，我们引入了两个经调优的模型：（1）电生理条件化VLA（EC-VLA），将8通道肌电包络作为连续条件输入，与前感知向量拼接；（2）视觉标注VLA（VA-VLA），将视觉分割标注引入图像输入。在三名受试者参与的立方体选择任务中，EC-VLA在无杂乱、分布内条件下与基于语言提示的基线模型表现相当，而在杂乱、分布外场景中则显著优于基线。类似地，VA-VLA在分布内场景中较基于语言提示的基线模型有适度提升，而在杂乱、分布外试验中则表现出显著进步。两项结果共同为超越语言的任务条件设置所可能带来的增益提供了有力证据。

title: 3DROID: A Renderable 3D Gaussian Dataset with Measured Per-Scene Reliability
summary: Robot manipulation models primarily reason from 2D observations while acting in the 3D physical world. To bridge this gap, recent work has augmented robot data with geometric priors such as depth, point clouds, and 3D trajectories, while renderable 3D Gaussian representations provide another promising form of 3D supervision. However, 3DGS representation is designed mainly for photometric fidelity and may not preserve real-world metric scale, particularly when the supplied camera extrinsics are unreliable. We study the effect of extrinsic reliability and pose conditioning on feed-forward 3DGS, and propose a calibration-aware pipeline that anchors reconstructed scenes to the robot's metric workspace. Our experiments show that pose conditioning improves novel-view fidelity, while its geometric benefit depends on the reliability of the injected extrinsics. Using this pipeline, we present a renderable, metric-pose-anchored dataset with scene-level reliability information for robot manipulation research. Our dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/wonguen/3DROID
tldr: This paper introduces 3DROID, a renderable 3D Gaussian dataset for robot manipulation, with a calibration-aware pipeline that anchors reconstructed scenes to the robot's metric workspace and provides per-scene reliability information.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了 3DROID，一个用于机器人操作的、可渲染的 3D 高斯数据集，其校准感知管道将重建场景锚定到机器人的度量工作空间，并提供每个场景的可靠性信息。
summary_zh: 机器人操作模型主要基于二维观测进行推理，却在三维物理世界中执行操作。为弥合这一差距，近期研究通过深度图、点云和三维轨迹等几何先验增强机器人数据，而可渲染的三维高斯表示则提供了另一种颇具前景的三维监督形式。然而，三维高斯表示主要针对光度保真度设计，可能无法保持真实世界中的度量尺度，尤其是在所提供的相机外参不可靠的情况下。我们研究了外参可靠性及位姿条件化对前馈三维高斯表示的影响，并提出了一种标定感知流水线，将重建场景锚定到机器人的度量工作空间中。实验表明，位姿条件化能够提升新视角保真度，而其几何方面的收益则取决于所注入外参的可靠性。利用该流水线，我们构建了一个可渲染、具有度量位姿锚定的数据集，并附带场景级可靠性信息，以供机器人操作研究使用。我们的数据集可在 https://huggingface.co/datasets/wonguen/3DROID 获取。

title: World Motion Models: Flexible Sequence Modeling of SE(3) Trajectories
summary: Equipping artificial agents with spatial intelligence requires a comprehensive generative prior over the dynamic 3D world. We propose World Motion Models (WMMs) that capture "what was, is, and will be where across time" via sparse SE(3) pose trajectories. WMMs are built on the observation that elements of dynamic scenes can be well approximated by a set of rigid SE(3) trajectories, a minimal yet expressive primitive for 4D modeling. This representation unifies articulated objects, human bodies, hand-object interactions, piecewise-rigid scene dynamics, camera motion, and even robot states and actions into a single shared space. Given this representation, we cast the joint distribution of these entities as a flexible sequence modeling problem, utilizing flow-matching with per-token noise levels. Coupled with a context token mechanism for non-sequential conditioning, this formulation supports any-to-any marginal conditioning across an arbitrary number of entities and time steps. Tasks such as future prediction, motion infilling, model-predictive control, inverse kinematics, cross-embodiment retargeting, and policy learning all reduce to the application of different masks over the same network. Experiments on 6 diverse applications of 3D vision and robotics demonstrate the versatility and flexibility of WMMs with strong performance.
tldr: This paper introduces World Motion Models (WMMs), a unified sequence modeling framework over SE(3) pose trajectories with flow matching, enabling diverse tasks such as future prediction, motion infilling, model-predictive control, and policy learning across various 3D vision and robotics applications.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了世界运动模型（WMM），一种基于SE(3)位姿轨迹的流匹配统一序列建模框架，可支持未来预测、运动插补、模型预测控制及策略学习等多种3D视觉与机器人任务。
summary_zh: 为人工代理赋予空间智能，需要针对动态三维世界建立一个全面的生成先验。我们提出了世界运动模型（World Motion Models, WMMs），通过稀疏的SE(3)位姿轨迹捕捉“何处曾有何物、现在有何物、未来将有何物”。WMMs建立在这样一个观察基础之上：动态场景中的元素可以被一组刚性SE(3)轨迹很好地近似，这是一种用于四维建模的极简且富有表现力的基本单元。该表示将关节物体、人体、手物交互、分段刚体的场景动态、相机运动，甚至机器人状态与动作，统一到一个共享空间中。基于这一表示，我们将这些实体的联合分布转化为一个灵活的序列建模问题，利用带有逐令牌噪声水平的流匹配方法。结合用于非序列条件设置的上下文令牌机制，该公式支持对任意数量的实体和时间步进行任意到任意的边际条件处理。诸如未来预测、运动插补、模型预测控制、逆运动学、跨实体重定向以及策略学习等任务，均可归结为在同一个网络上应用不同的掩码。在3D视觉与机器人领域的6项多样化应用上的实验，展示了WMMs的通用性与灵活性，并取得了强劲的性能表现。

title: ReCo: Response-Consistent Locomotion with Policy-Aware MPC for Legged Manipulation
summary: Continuous legged manipulation requires accurate end-effector tracking while the base keeps walking. Combining reinforcement learning (RL) with model predictive control (MPC) suits this task: the learned policy provides robust locomotion, while MPC coordinates the base and arm to compensate for tracking errors. However, MPC can compensate only for base motion that it can predict, and a learned policy's command response varies with gait phase, contact, and payload. We present ReCo, a framework that couples response-consistent locomotion with policy-aware MPC for legged manipulation. Response shaping trains the policy to respond to commands consistently and repeatably across randomized dynamics. An identified closed-loop response model then lets MPC jointly plan locomotion commands and arm motion. On the simulation benchmark, ReCo reduces position and orientation root-mean-square error (RMSE) by 28.7% and 27.4% relative to the best baseline for each metric. Real-world experiments demonstrate onboard continuous legged manipulation with coordinated base and arm motion.
tldr: ReCo introduces a framework that combines RL-based locomotion with policy-aware MPC for legged manipulation, using response shaping to ensure consistent command tracking and an identified closed-loop model for coordinated base and arm planning, achieving significant error reductions in simulation and real-world deployment.
tldr_zh: ReCo 提出了一种结合 RL 运动策略与策略感知 MPC 的四足操作框架，通过响应整形确保命令跟踪一致性，并利用闭环模型协调基座与机械臂运动，在仿真和真实实验中显著降低跟踪误差。
summary_zh: 连续腿部操作要求在基座持续行走的同时实现精确的末端执行器跟踪。将强化学习（RL）与模型预测控制（MPC）相结合适用于该任务：学习到的策略提供稳健的运动控制，而MPC协调基座与手臂以补偿跟踪误差。然而，MPC只能补偿其能够预测的基座运动，且学习策略的命令响应随步态相位、接触状态和负载而变化。我们提出ReCo框架，该框架将响应一致的运动控制与策略感知的MPC相结合，用于腿部操作。响应整形训练策略在随机化动力学条件下对命令做出一致且可重复的响应。随后，一个辨识得到的闭环响应模型使MPC能够联合规划运动控制命令和手臂运动。在仿真基准测试中，ReCo将位置和方向均方根误差（RMSE）相对于各项指标的最佳基线分别降低了28.7%和27.4%。真实世界实验展示了在机载条件下，基座与手臂协调运动的连续腿部操作。

title: FedCKA: Representation-Guided Layer Personalization for Federated 3D Perception Across Driving Domains
summary: Robust perception in intelligent vehicles demands 3D object detectors that remain dependable under domain shifts, such as changes in time of day, location, or weather. However, due to costly annotation and rare shifts, some environments lack sufficient data to train a standalone detector. Federated learning offers a privacy-preserving framework for collaborative model training, enabling clients to benefit from shared learning across diverse environments. Yet, this framework traditionally relies on a single global consensus model, which struggles to perform across heterogeneous local data distributions. Local conditions are better captured by adapting a subset of the model, but many personalization approaches rely on predefined layer partitions or fixed personalization ratios, thereby limiting adaptation to client-specific divergence. To reduce this rigidity, we propose FedCKA, a Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA)-based strategy that dynamically handles the personalization-globalization trade-off. Specifically, FedCKA computes layer-wise feature similarities between local client models and the global consensus model during training. By converting layer-wise similarity scores into client-specific aggregation masks, FedCKA selectively shares representation-consistent layers. Evaluation on a unified multi-domain benchmark based on nuScenes shows that FedCKA outperforms established federated baselines, including FedBN, FedRep, and FedSelect, improving average NDS by 7 percentage points over the strongest baseline. The findings offer both a comparative benchmark and a promising direction for robust federated 3D perception across shifts in location, weather, and illumination. Code is available at https://github.com/j-verhoog/FedCKA.
tldr: FedCKA introduces a CKA-based dynamic layer personalization method for federated 3D perception in autonomous driving, which improves multi-domain object detection under domain shifts.
tldr_zh: FedCKA提出了一种基于CKA的动态层个性化方法，用于自动驾驶中的联邦3D感知，提升了多域目标检测在域偏移下的表现。
summary_zh: 智能车辆中的稳健感知要求3D目标检测器在域偏移（如一天中时间、地点或天气的变化）下依然保持可靠性。然而，由于标注成本高昂且偏移场景罕见，某些环境缺乏足够的数据来独立训练检测器。联邦学习提供了一种隐私保护的协作模型训练框架，使客户端能够从跨多样环境的共享学习中受益。然而，该框架传统上依赖单一的全局共识模型，难以在异构的本地数据分布上取得良好表现。通过适配模型子集可以更好地捕捉本地条件，但许多个性化方法依赖于预定义的层划分或固定的个性化比例，从而限制了对客户端特定差异的适应能力。为降低这种刚性，我们提出FedCKA，一种基于中心核对齐（CKA）的策略，能够动态处理个性化与全局化之间的权衡。具体而言，FedCKA在训练过程中计算本地客户端模型与全局共识模型之间的逐层特征相似度。通过将逐层相似度分数转换为客户端特定的聚合掩码，FedCKA选择性地共享表示一致的层。在基于nuScenes构建的统一多域基准上的评估表明，FedCKA优于已建立的联邦基线方法（包括FedBN、FedRep和FedSelect），相较最强基线，平均NDS提升了7个百分点。研究结果既提供了一个对比基准，也为跨地点、天气和光照偏移的稳健联邦3D感知指明了有前景的方向。代码可在https://github.com/j-verhoog/FedCKA获取。

title: Continue, Abort, or Fall: Viability-Aware Policy Selection (VAPS) for Safe Humanoid Acrobatics
summary: Dynamic humanoid motions such as flips risk hardware damage due to suboptimal policies, disturbances or sim-to-real gaps. A motion tracking policy offers no way out once the maneuver leaves its reference, and a backup policy needs to take over to protect the hardware for a minimum-damage landing. Which backup to use matters as much as when to switch. We present Viability-Aware Policy Selection (VAPS), which treats safety as a policy-conditioned, receding-horizon decision. Besides a protective fall policy, we also train an abort policy which can abort the motion at any time, landing on its feet. At every control step, learned predictors estimate whether the nominal tracking policy and the abort policy remain viable over a short horizon, and a least-sacrificial hierarchy keeps the most task-ambitious behavior that remains viable. In simulation with randomized disturbances, VAPS sharply reduces head contact and hand contact, which are the dominant sources of hardware damage, with both a Unitree G1 and a LimX Oli; on the LimX Oli, we validate the viability predictors and the full VAPS controller for side-flip motions. VAPS Pareto-dominates the strongest single-network alternatives we could train, including an end-to-end safe-tracking policy and students distilled from VAPS's own oracle-routed decisions, in both task success and head impact. We also show that VAPS is a powerful framework to supervise undertrained policies and protect the hardware.
tldr: VAPS proposes a viability-aware policy selection framework for safe humanoid acrobatics, using learned predictors to switch between tracking, abort, and fall policies in a receding-horizon manner, reducing hardware damage in simulation and on real robots.
tldr_zh: VAPS 提出了一种面向安全人形机器人特技的可行性感知策略选择框架，利用学习预测器在滚动时域内切换跟踪、中止和摔倒策略，在仿真和真实机器人上减少硬件损伤。
summary_zh: 动态类人动作（如空翻）可能因次优策略、扰动或仿真与现实的差距而导致硬件损坏。一旦动作偏离参考轨迹，运动跟踪策略便无计可施，此时需要备份策略接管，以最小损伤方式着陆保护硬件。选择何种备份策略与何时切换同样关键。我们提出了可行性感知策略选择（VAPS）方法，将安全性视为一种策略条件化的滚动时域决策问题。除保护性摔倒策略外，我们还训练了一种中止策略，可在任意时刻中止当前动作并双脚着地。在每个控制步中，学习型预测器评估标称跟踪策略和中止策略在短时域内是否仍然可行，并通过最小牺牲层级机制，始终保持最具任务进取性且仍然可行的行为。在含随机扰动的仿真中，VAPS显著减少了头部接触和手部接触——这两者是硬件损伤的主要来源——在Unitree G1和LimX Oli两款机器人上均得到验证；在LimX Oli上，我们针对侧空翻动作验证了可行性预测器及完整VAPS控制器。在任务成功率和头部冲击两方面，VAPS帕累托优于我们所能训练的最强单网络替代方案，包括端到端安全跟踪策略以及从VAPS自身神谕路由决策中蒸馏得到的学生网络。我们还展示了VAPS作为强大框架，可有效监督训练不足的策略并保护硬件。

title: PROMO: Preference-conditioned Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning for Quadrupedal Robots
summary: Quadrupedal locomotion requires balancing conflicting objectives such as command tracking, stability, and energy efficiency, yet conventional reinforcement learning (RL) hardcodes these priorities into a fixed scalar reward at training time. We present PROMO (Preference-Conditioned Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning), a semantic multi-objective approach that makes this trade-off an explicit runtime input to a single locomotion policy. PROMO conditions the policy on deployment facing preferences while keeping embodiment-specific locomotion priors fixed, thereby separating operator intent from reward shaping terms required for viable gait generation. Compared with fixed-objective controllers, multi-objective baselines, and independently trained specialists, PROMO achieves objective specialization and robustness from a single deployable policy. Across 100 sampled preferences in simulation, 67 behaviors are non-dominated under exact Pareto dominance, with a mean preference-objective correlation of 0.843, demonstrating broad Pareto coverage and predictable preference response. The same policy transfers zero-shot to a Unitree Go2, where preference changes alone reduce specific energy by up to 30.4%, position error by 38.7%, and peak body-attitude deviation by 59.0% relative to the balanced preference. These results establish preference-conditioned multi-objective RL as a practical runtime interface for adaptive legged locomotion, extending its role beyond offline Pareto-set construction. Open-source code and videos are available at https://amrmousa.com/promo/.
tldr: PROMO introduces a preference-conditioned multi-objective RL method for quadrupedal locomotion, enabling a single policy to trade off objectives like command tracking, stability, and energy efficiency at runtime, with zero-shot transfer to a real Unitree Go2 robot.
tldr_zh: PROMO 提出了一种偏好条件化的多目标强化学习方法，用于四足运动，使单一策略能够在运行时权衡目标（如指令跟踪、稳定性和能效），并零样本迁移到真实的 Unitree Go2 机器人上。
summary_zh: 四足运动需要在指令跟踪、稳定性和能量效率等相互冲突的目标之间进行平衡，然而传统的强化学习（RL）方法在训练时将这些优先级硬编码为固定的标量奖励。我们提出了PROMO（偏好条件化的多目标强化学习），这是一种语义多目标方法，将这种权衡作为显式的运行时输入注入到单一运动策略中。PROMO在保持与具体机体相关的运动先验固定不变的同时，使策略以部署时的偏好为条件，从而将操作者意图与生成可行步态所需的奖励塑形项分离开来。与固定目标控制器、多目标基线以及独立训练的专业策略相比，PROMO通过单一可部署策略实现了目标专门化与鲁棒性。在仿真中采样的100种偏好下，67种行为在精确Pareto支配意义下为非支配解，偏好-目标平均相关性为0.843，展示了广泛的Pareto覆盖范围和可预测的偏好响应。同一策略零样本迁移至Unitree Go2机器人，相对于均衡偏好，仅改变偏好即可将比能耗降低最多30.4%，位置误差降低38.7%，机体姿态峰值偏差降低59.0%。这些结果表明，偏好条件化的多目标强化学习可作为自适应腿式运动的实用运行时接口，将其作用拓展至离线Pareto前沿构建之外。开源代码和视频见 https://amrmousa.com/promo/。

title: ColoACT: Multi-Cue Action Chunking for Smooth Autonomous Colon Navigation on a Self-Propelled Endoscopic Robot
summary: Autonomous colonoscopic navigation can reduce operator burden and the risk of loop formation or tissue trauma, but remains challenging due to deformable anatomy, weak-texture and specular endoscopic visuals, and contact-rich viscoelastic interactions. Existing methods either rely on geometry-driven pipelines, which are efficient and interpretable yet brittle due to manually engineered features and switching logic, or adopt learning-based policies, whose inferred depth/geometry can become temporally inconsistent or overly smooth under weak texture and specular highlights while simulation-trained variants (e.g., deep reinforcement learning) may further suffer from a sim-to-real gap. We propose ColoACT, an autonomous navigation system that integrates an RGB-D-E based Action Chunking Transformer policy (ColoACT policy) for a compact self-propelled Bevel-Gear-Based Endoscopic Robot (BGER). The ColoACT policy augments RGB with estimated relative depth and a gradient-based pseudo-elevation map to enhance fold-ridge saliency and other high-frequency geometric cues, and enables smooth continuous control of the BGER by predicting overlapping action chunks and fusing them via temporal ensembling. In different \textit{ex-vivo} porcine colons (approximately 60 cm), our system achieves success rates of 85.4\% and 72.5\% in straight and curved segments, respectively, and achieves 70\% success in 90-degree turns and 60\% in double-bend sequences, with feasibility further demonstrated in challenging triple-bend segments. The project page is available at: https://Adamhu1.github.io/ColoACT/.
tldr: ColoACT integrates an Action Chunking Transformer policy with RGB-D-E inputs and temporal ensembling for autonomous navigation of a self-propelled endoscopic robot in ex-vivo porcine colons, achieving robust success in straight, curved, and highly tortuous segments.
tldr_zh: ColoACT将动作分块Transformer策略与RGB-D-E输入及时间集成相结合，用于自推进内窥镜机器人在离体猪结肠中的自主导航，在直线、弯曲和高迂回段中均实现了可靠的导航成功率。
summary_zh: 自主结肠镜导航能够减轻操作者负担，并降低襻形成或组织损伤的风险，但由于解剖结构的可变形性、内窥镜图像中弱纹理与镜面反射的存在，以及富含接触的黏弹性交互作用，该任务仍具有挑战性。现有方法要么依赖基于几何驱动的流程，其高效且可解释，但因人工设计的特征和切换逻辑而显得脆弱；要么采用基于学习的策略，其推断出的深度/几何信息在弱纹理和镜面反射条件下可能产生时间上不一致或过度平滑的结果，而基于仿真训练的方法（例如深度强化学习）还可能面临仿真到现实的差距问题。我们提出了ColoACT，一种自主导航系统，集成了基于RGB-D-E的动作分块变压器策略（ColoACT策略），用于驱动紧凑型自推进式锥齿轮内窥镜机器人（BGER）。ColoACT策略将RGB图像与估计的相对深度以及基于梯度的伪高程图相结合，以增强褶皱嵴显著性及其他高频几何线索，并通过预测重叠动作分块及时间集成融合的方式，实现对BGER的平滑连续控制。在不同离体猪结肠（约60厘米）中，我们的系统在直段和弯曲段的成功率分别达到85.4%和72.5%，在90度转弯处成功率达70%，在双弯序列中成功率达60%，并进一步在具有挑战性的三弯段中验证了其可行性。项目页面可在以下网址访问：https://Adamhu1.github.io/ColoACT/。

title: Recova: Agent-Guided Failure Recovery for Autonomous Robotic Manipulation
summary: Manipulation failures can leave scenes in states from which a task policy cannot recover. Learning corrective behaviors requires scalable failure exploration and physical grounding. We present Recova, an agent-guided framework that jointly develops task execution and recovery in a reconstructed digital twin, then verifies and refines both through real-world experience. In the twin, the agent diagnoses failures, tests corrective programs, and collects successful task and recovery rollouts for separate policies. During deployment, it monitors progress, invokes a learned or programmatic recovery, verifies scene restoration, and resumes execution. When no suitable recovery is available, a human demonstration resolves the failure and enters the learning loop, allowing the system to expand its recovery capabilities. Physical rollouts and human demonstrations are routed to the corresponding policy for DAgger training. Across six LIBERO-Pro settings and four MolmoSpaces categories, Recova achieves 78.8% and 64.9% mean success, compared with 71.7% and 38.0% for the strongest baselines. With parallel collection across four real-robot workstations, DAgger fine-tuning raises mean success from 23.8% to 77.5%, and recovery skills further raise it to 87.5%. Over four collection rounds on one task, observed human intervention falls from 87.5% to 0%. Together, these results show how agent-guided recovery turns failures into reusable capabilities, improving robustness while progressively reducing human intervention. Project page: https://www.liuisabella.com/Recova
tldr: Recova is an agent-guided framework that improves robotic manipulation robustness by jointly learning task execution and recovery policies in a digital twin, then refining them via real-world DAgger training, reducing human intervention across LIBERO and real-robot tasks.
tldr_zh: Recova 是一种智能体引导的框架，通过在数字孪生中联合学习任务执行与恢复策略，并在真实世界中通过 DAgger 训练进行优化，从而提升机器人操作的鲁棒性并减少人工干预。
summary_zh: 操作失败可能使场景陷入任务策略无法恢复的状态。学习纠正行为需要可扩展的失败探索和物理 grounding。我们提出 Recova，一个智能体引导的框架，在重建的数字孪生中联合开发任务执行与恢复策略，并通过真实世界经验对两者进行验证和细化。在孪生环境中，智能体诊断失败、测试纠正程序，并为任务策略和恢复策略分别收集成功的 rollout 数据。部署期间，系统监控进度，调用学习式或程序化恢复机制，验证场景恢复状态，然后继续执行。当没有合适的恢复方案时，人工演示解决失败并进入学习循环，使系统扩展其恢复能力。物理 rollout 和人工演示被路由到相应策略进行 DAgger 训练。在六个 LIBERO-Pro 设置和四个 MolmoSpaces 类别中，Recova 的平均成功率分别达到 78.8% 和 64.9%，而最强基线的成功率分别为 71.7% 和 38.0%。通过在四个真实机器人工作站上进行并行数据采集，DAgger 微调将平均成功率从 23.8% 提升至 77.5%，恢复技能进一步将其提升至 87.5%。在单个任务的四轮数据采集中，观察到的人工干预率从 87.5% 下降至 0%。综合来看，这些结果表明智能体引导的恢复机制如何将失败转化为可复用的能力，在提升鲁棒性的同时逐步减少人工干预。项目页面：https://www.liuisabella.com/Recova

title: Experience-Based Feasibility-Aware Generative Adversarial Imitation from Observation under Embodiment Mismatch
summary: With the increasing use of robot-free demonstration interfaces that provide state trajectories without action labels, imitation from observation has become a promising approach for learning robot behaviors from human demonstrations. However, due to differences in embodiment and dynamics between humans and robots, demonstrated human motions may not be feasible for the robot, potentially degrading policy performance. In this study, we propose Experience-Based Feasibility-Aware Generative Adversarial Imitation from Observation (EF-GAIfO), which estimates the feasibility of state-only demonstrations from the robot's own experience rather than relying on explicit dynamics models or large prior exploration datasets. A key feature of EF-GAIfO is that the notion of feasibility evolves with policy learning: as the policy improves and the robot experiences a broader range of state transitions, the feasible region is progressively expanded, allowing additional demonstrations to be incorporated into learning. This enables feasibility-aware imitation that adapts to the current stage of policy learning, rather than relying on a pre-designed feasibility criterion. We validate the effectiveness of EF-GAIfO on a locomotion task in simulation and on a real quadruped robot performing a object-reaching-and-grasping task.
tldr: This paper proposes EF-GAIfO, a method for imitation from observation that estimates the feasibility of human demonstrations for a robot using the robot's own experience, and progressively expands the feasible region as the policy improves. It is validated on a simulated locomotion task and a real quadruped robot grasping task.
tldr_zh: 本文提出EF-GAIfO，一种从观察中模仿的方法，利用机器人自身经验估计人类演示对机器人的可行性，并随着策略改进逐步扩大可行区域。在仿真 locomotion 任务和真实四足机器人抓取任务上进行了验证。
summary_zh: 随着越来越多无需动作标签、仅提供状态轨迹的机器人免示教接口的出现，从观察中模仿学习已成为从人类示教中习得机器人行为的一种颇具前景的方法。然而，由于人类与机器人在本体结构和动力学方面存在差异，所展示的人类动作可能无法直接适用于机器人，从而可能导致策略性能下降。在本研究中，我们提出了一种基于经验的可行性感知生成式对抗性观察模仿学习方法（EF-GAIfO），该方法从机器人自身的经验出发估计仅状态示教的可行性，而不依赖显式的动力学模型或大规模的先验探索数据集。EF-GAIfO的一个关键特点是，其可行性的概念会随着策略学习的过程不断演进：随着策略的改善以及机器人经历更广泛的状态转移，可行区域逐步扩展，从而允许更多示教数据被纳入学习之中。这实现了能够适应当前策略学习阶段的可行性感知模仿学习，而非依赖于预设的可行性准则。我们在仿真环境中的运动控制任务以及真实四足机器人执行的物体触及与抓取任务上，验证了EF-GAIfO的有效性。

title: WBAG: A Whole-Body and Attached-Geometry Safety Framework for Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies have demonstrated impressive capabilities in generalizable robotic manipulation, but their deployment in the real world remains challenging due to potential collisions involving different parts of the robot, manipulated objects, and the surrounding environment. Existing inference-time VLA safety frameworks typically rely on simplified end-effector-centered representations that do not explicitly model the full articulated robot and attached-object geometry. In this paper, we present WBAG, a safety framework that models the robot's whole-body and grasp-dependent attached geometry. WBAG constructs a grasp-conditioned safe set that adapts the protected geometry as objects are grasped, then converts this evolving geometry into differentiable CBF constraints that minimally modify the VLA's native six-dimensional operational-space action for collision avoidance across robot, scene, and attached geometry. On the SafeLIBERO benchmark, a variant of LIBERO augmented with obstacles for safety evaluation, WBAG achieves the best overall safety and safe task success among the evaluated methods under a scene-level safety evaluator that monitors all eligible non-task objects, reaching 97.38\% aggregate Scene Safety and 59.38\% Safe Success.
tldr: WBAG is a safety framework for VLA manipulation policies that models the robot's whole-body and attached-object geometry using grasp-conditioned safe sets and differentiable CBF constraints, achieving state-of-the-art safety on the SafeLIBERO benchmark.
tldr_zh: WBAG是一个面向VLA操作策略的安全框架，通过建模机器人全身及抓取物体几何，并结合可微CBF约束，在SafeLIBERO基准上实现了最佳安全性。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在泛化机器人操作中展现了令人印象深刻的能力，但其在现实世界中的部署仍面临挑战，原因在于机器人不同部位、被操作物体以及周围环境之间可能发生的碰撞。现有的推理时VLA安全框架通常依赖于简化的以末端执行器为中心的表征，未显式建模完整的关节式机器人及附着物体的几何结构。在本文中，我们提出WBAG，一种对机器人全身及依赖抓取的附着几何结构进行建模的安全框架。WBAG构建了一个抓取条件安全集，在抓取物体时自适应调整受保护的几何结构，进而将该动态演化的几何结构转换为可微分的CBF约束，以最小化方式修改VLA原生的六维操作空间动作，从而在机器人、场景及附着几何结构之间实现碰撞规避。在SafeLIBERO基准（一个为安全评估而增加障碍物的LIBERO变体）上，在监控所有符合条件的非任务物体的场景级安全评估器下，WBAG在评估方法中取得了最佳的整体安全性能和安全任务成功率，场景安全性聚合指标达到97.38%，安全成功率达到59.38%。

title: Closed-Loop Refinement and Execution for Learned Driving Planners
summary: Learning-based driving planners are usually trained and evaluated in open loop against logged trajectories. In closed loop, a trajectory with small displacement error can still stall the vehicle, steer it into a conflict with surrounding agents, or be executed with abrupt braking. We introduce Closed-Loop Refinement and Execution (CLRE), a hierarchical receding-horizon control framework designed to mitigate these failure modes while leaving the upstream planner frozen and adding no new learned model. The upper layer treats the nominal trajectory as a reference and solves a finite-horizon optimal control problem that trades route progress against interaction with predicted agents. Solving it from several initializations gives a candidate set, and a prediction-conditioned oriented-bounding-box (OBB) feasibility test retains only candidates whose minimum predicted OBB clearance over the horizon meets a threshold. The lower layer executes the lowest-cost survivor, or a route-centerline backup when none remains, through the tracking controller supplied with the planner, augmented by a range-based speed bound and a saturated proportional braking law. In closed-loop simulation on 126 Bench2Drive routes with VAD as the upstream planner, CLRE raises the driving score from 43.41 to 56.42 and route completion from 57.27 to 72.23, and reduces collision events from 70 to 53.
tldr: CLRE is a hierarchical receding-horizon control framework that refines and executes nominal trajectories from learned driving planners in closed loop, improving driving scores and reducing collisions without modifying the upstream planner or adding new learned models.
tldr_zh: CLRE 是一个分层滚动时域控制框架，在闭环中优化并执行学习型驾驶规划器的名义轨迹，在不修改上游规划器或添加新学习模型的情况下提高驾驶分数并减少碰撞。
summary_zh: 基于学习的驾驶规划器通常在开环条件下，依据记录轨迹进行训练与评估。而在闭环中，即使位移误差很小的轨迹，也可能导致车辆停驶、与周围智能体发生冲突，或执行过程中出现急刹车。为此，我们提出闭环细化与执行（Closed-Loop Refinement and Execution, CLRE）框架，一种分层滚动时域控制方法，旨在缓解上述失效模式，同时保持上游规划器不变，且不引入任何新的学习模型。上层将名义轨迹视为参考，求解一个有限时域最优控制问题，在路线推进与对预测智能体的交互之间进行权衡。从多个初始值出发求解该问题，可得到候选轨迹集合；随后，通过基于预测条件的定向包围盒（OBB）可行性测试，仅保留在预测时域内最小OBB间隙达到阈值的候选轨迹。下层则通过规划器自带的跟踪控制器执行代价最低的幸存候选轨迹，若无任何候选幸存，则退而执行路线中心线备用轨迹；同时，控制器辅以基于距离的速度限制和饱和比例制动律。在Bench2Drive的126条路线闭环仿真中，以VAD作为上游规划器，CLRE将驾驶得分从43.41提升至56.42，路线完成率从57.27提升至72.23，并将碰撞事件次数从70次降至53次。

title: NarrativeFlow: Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Model Using Robot Velocity Fields
summary: We focus on language-conditioned flow-based manipulation, where robot flows (robot velocity fields) serve as embodiment-agnostic, motion-centric representations for leveraging data collected from multiple robot platforms. This task is crucial because language-conditioned manipulation is essential for practical robotic systems, yet scaling robot foundation models remains limited by the labor-intensive collection of embodiment-specific data. Existing methods either coarsely approximate robot flows with sparse keypoint displacements, or cannot handle language-conditioned manipulation. To address this limitation, we propose NarrativeFlow, which models robot flows as continuous velocity fields using a flow-matching formulation conditioned on language. Accordingly, NarrativeFlow generates robot flows that are physically consistent with real-world manipulation. To validate NarrativeFlow, we have conducted experiments on standard datasets for language-conditioned manipulation. The experimental results show that NarrativeFlow outperforms representative baseline methods on standard evaluation metrics. Furthermore, through real-world experiments, we show that NarrativeFlow achieves higher success rates than baseline methods across multiple manipulation tasks. The project page is available at https://shota0520.github.io/NarrativeFlow-project-page/
tldr: NarrativeFlow is a flow-based vision-language-action model that generates robot velocity fields via flow-matching conditioned on language, enabling embodiment-agnostic manipulation policies trained on multi-platform data and validated on standard benchmarks and real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: NarrativeFlow 是一种基于流的视觉-语言-动作模型，通过条件于语言的流匹配生成机器人速度场，实现跨平台的多机器人操控策略，并在标准基准和真实世界任务中验证。
summary_zh:
摘要：
我们聚焦于基于语言条件的流式操作，其中机器人流（即机器人速度场）作为一种与具身无关、以运动为中心的表征，用于充分利用从多种机器人平台收集的数据。这一任务至关重要，因为基于语言条件的操作对实际机器人系统不可或缺，然而机器人基础模型的规模化发展仍受限于具身特定数据采集的高人力成本。现有方法要么通过稀疏关键点位移粗略近似机器人流，要么无法处理基于语言条件的操作。为解决这一局限，我们提出了NarrativeFlow，该方法采用基于语言条件的流匹配框架，将机器人流建模为连续速度场。由此，NarrativeFlow生成的机器人流与实际操作在物理上保持一致。为验证NarrativeFlow的有效性，我们在标准语言条件操作数据集上开展了实验。实验结果表明，NarrativeFlow在标准评估指标上优于代表性基线方法。此外，通过真实世界实验，我们展示了NarrativeFlow在多项操作任务中均取得了比基线方法更高的成功率。项目页面可访问：https://shota0520.github.io/NarrativeFlow-project-page/

title: Screw Attention: Rigid-Body Algebra Inside a Transformer
summary: Learned manipulation policies rediscover from data the spatial relations that rigid-body mechanics supplies in closed form. This costs data, and it leaves the policies fragile to geometric changes in the scene. We present Screw Attention, a transformer layer in which the relation between two bodies is a spatial transform rather than a graph edge. Every token is a body with a pose. Each pair of tokens carries the relative pose and, for robot joints, the joint screw. Messages are transported along this relation into the receiver's frame, while the attention scores see only frame-invariant quantities. By construction, the messages are equivariant to an independent change of frame at every token, and a single layer can express the velocity recursion of rigid-body mechanics. On simulated manipulation tasks, Screw Attention matches or outperforms controls of the same size, including graph, transformer and flat networks on LIBERO-Spatial. With 16,162 parameters it reaches 97.3% on LIBERO-Spatial from object poses (without images or language), above a flat network with 27x more parameters. Under a change of per-link frame convention its success is unchanged, while every other learned network falls below 3%. Placed on an analytic controller as a gated residual, it raises insertion success by 17.3 points. It is unaffected by pose noise up to 10,mm and by joint offsets within the factory calibration of a Franka arm. These results suggest a criterion: geometry is decisive when the task requires relations between frames that no other part of the system supplies. Code and trained policies will be released.
tldr: Screw Attention introduces a transformer layer where token relations are rigid-body spatial transforms and relative poses, achieving equivariance to frame changes and strong simulated manipulation performance, especially under geometric perturbations.
tldr_zh: Screw Attention 提出一种 transformer 层，将 token 间关系建模为刚体空间变换与相对位姿，实现相对于坐标系变化的等变性，并在模拟操作任务中取得优异性能，尤其对几何扰动鲁棒。
summary_zh: 学习到的操控策略从数据中重新发现了刚体力学以闭式形式提供的空间关系。这需要大量数据，并且使得策略对场景中的几何变化较为脆弱。我们提出了螺旋注意力（Screw Attention），一种变压器层，其中两个物体之间的关系是空间变换而非图边。每个令牌是一个具有位姿的物体。每对令牌携带相对位姿，对于机器人关节，还携带关节螺旋。消息沿此关系传输到接收者的坐标系中，而注意力分数仅看到坐标系不变的量。通过构造，消息对每个令牌处坐标系的独立变化具有等变性，且单层即可表达刚体力学的速度递推。在模拟操控任务中，螺旋注意力在相同规模的控制模型上达到或超越表现，包括在LIBERO-Spatial上的图网络、变压器网络和全连接网络。仅用16，162个参数，在仅基于物体位姿（无图像或语言）的LIBERO-Spatial任务上达到97.3%的准确率，超过了参数数量多27倍的全连接网络。在逐连杆坐标系约定变化下，其成功率保持不变，而所有其他学习网络成功率均降至3%以下。作为门控残差置于解析控制器之上时，它将插入任务成功率提升了17.3个百分点。对于高达10毫米的位姿噪声以及Franka机械臂出厂标定范围内的关节偏移，其性能不受影响。这些结果表明了一个准则：当任务需要系统中其他部分无法提供的坐标系间关系时，几何信息具有决定性作用。代码和训练好的策略将予以公开。

title: TOAST: Stochastic Robot Action Tokenization for Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action models often represent continuous robot actions as discrete token sequences, enabling action prediction with standard next-token objectives. FAST has substantially improved this representation by compactly encoding action containing diverse temporal frequencies into relatively few tokens. However, while such compression reduces the number of action tokens required for autoregressive prediction, it does not necessarily improve the efficiency of policy learning from limited demonstrations. In particular, FAST typically assigns a single deterministic tokenization to each quantized action sequence, although multiple token sequences can represent and decode to the same robot motion. We investigate whether exploiting this representational redundancy can improve policy learning. In this paper, we propose TOkenization of Action sequences with STochastic sampling (TOAST), a stochastic action tokenization method that samples alternative tokenizations of the same quantized action sequence during policy training. This diversifies the discrete supervision while preserving the underlying robot action and requires no additional demonstrations. Experiments on LIBERO show that TOAST consistently improves over its deterministic counterpart, with the improvement increasing as training data decreases, achieving a 6.8 point gain in success rate when only 1/16 of training data is available. Across four real-robot manipulation tasks, TOAST further improves mean success rate by 15.8 points over the deterministic counterpart. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of stochastic action tokenization for autoregressive robot policy learning, particularly when training data are limited.
tldr: TOAST proposes a stochastic action tokenization method that samples alternative tokenizations of the same quantized action sequence during policy training, improving autoregressive VLA policy learning, especially with limited data, as demonstrated on LIBERO and real-robot manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: TOAST 提出了一种随机动作标记化方法，在策略训练期间对同一量化动作序列的替代标记化进行采样，从而改进自回归 VLA 策略学习，尤其是在数据有限的情况下，在 LIBERO 和真实机器人操作任务上得到了验证。
summary_zh: 自回归视觉-语言-动作模型通常将连续的机器人动作表示为离散的token序列，从而能够通过标准的下一token预测目标实现动作预测。FAST通过将包含不同时间频率的紧凑动作编码为相对较少的token，显著改进了这一表示方式。然而，尽管这种压缩减少了自回归预测所需的动作token数量，却未必能提升从有限示范中学习策略的效率。具体而言，FAST通常为每个量化动作序列分配单一的确定性token化结果，尽管多个token序列可以表示并解码为相同的机器人运动。我们探究利用这种表示冗余是否能够改进策略学习。在本文中，我们提出了动作序列的随机token化方法（TOAST），这是一种在策略训练过程中对相同量化动作序列进行替代token化采样的随机动作token化方法。该方法在保持底层机器人动作不变的同时，使离散监督信号多样化，且无需额外的示范数据。在LIBERO上的实验表明，TOAST始终优于其确定性对应方法，且随着训练数据的减少，性能提升更加显著——当仅使用1/16的训练数据时，成功率提升了6.8个百分点。在四项真实机器人操作任务中，TOAST相比确定性对应方法进一步将平均成功率提升了15.8个百分点。这些结果证明了随机动作token化在自回归机器人策略学习中的有效性，尤其是在训练数据有限的情况下。

title: Kinematic MeanFlow: One-Step Action Generation Policy for Robotic Foundation Models
summary: In this paper, we study how to achieve one-step action generation in Robotic Foundation Models (RFMs), aiming to overcome the high inference latency of multi-step flow matching. MeanFlow provides a promising framework for this goal, yet its direct application leads to performance collapse. We discover that this stems from two distinctive dynamics exhibited in the RFM velocity field: (1) the ``local acceleration" exhibits stability early on, but surges sharply towards the end of the denoising process, and (2) the spread of its magnitudes across samples widens as denoising progresses. To address these issues, we introduce Kinematic MeanFlow (K-MF), a novel one-step action policy tailored for RFMs. Specifically, grounded in a kinematic identity, K-MF decouples the time derivative term in the MeanFlow formulation into two sub-interval terms separated by an intermediate point. This decoupled formulation enables the two terms to capture early-stage and late-stage denoising dynamics, respectively, while mitigating the error amplification across the process. As a result, our K-MF empowers RFMs to achieve one-step action generation in both training from scratch and fine-tuning paradigms across diverse tasks, while outperforming multi-step flow matching in most settings. In terms of inference efficiency, K-MF reduces action-head latency of GR00T-N1.6 by 67.5%~74.4% across L40 and Jetson Orin in eager and compiled modes, yielding end-to-end latency reductions of 30.3%~54.9%. Code will be available at https://github.com/IntelChina-AI/K-MF.
tldr: This paper proposes Kinematic MeanFlow, a one-step action generation policy for robotic foundation models, which decouples the MeanFlow velocity field into two sub-interval terms to avoid performance collapse and achieves significant inference speedup on GR00T-N1.6.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了运动学平均流（K-MF），一种用于机器人基础模型的一步动作生成策略，通过将平均流速度场解耦为两个子区间项来避免性能退化，并在GR00T-N1.6上实现了显著的推理加速。
summary_zh: 在本文中，我们研究了如何在机器人基础模型（RFMs）中实现单步动作生成，旨在克服多步流匹配的高推理延迟问题。MeanFlow为实现该目标提供了一个有前景的框架，然而直接应用它会导致性能崩溃。我们发

title: Are Frontier VLM Agents Ready to Be Robot Generalists? An Empirical Study with the Embodied Agent Arena
summary: Frontier vision-language models (VLMs) combine scene estimation, interaction grounding, and executable actions. Understanding how these abilities support complete robotic tasks is central to evaluating their readiness as robot generalists. We introduce Embodied Agent Arena to examine where local competence supports, or falls short of, complete task success across Geometry, Spatial Reasoning, Affordance, Task Planning, and Manipulation. The arena contains 1,000 cases drawn from 32 established sources and GeoProbe, our new benchmark for geometric estimation on Blender renders and real-scene images. A minimal harness preserves source observations and operations while separating metric precision, functional grounding, and native goal completion. We evaluate seven VLMs, analyze Astra's task-specific advantages, and compare richer-observation execution protocols and multi-round review. Across the arena, Astra's advantage is strongest in precise estimation and usable-contact localization; completing coordinated, goal-directed actions remains the key gap to robot generalism.
tldr: This paper introduces the Embodied Agent Arena, a benchmark with 1,000 cases across Geometry, Spatial Reasoning, Affordance, Task Planning, and Manipulation, to evaluate frontier VLM agents as robot generalists, finding that precise estimation and usable-contact localization are strengths while coordinated goal-directed actions remain a key gap.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了具身智能体竞技场，一个包含1000个案例的基准，涵盖几何、空间推理、可行使性、任务规划和操作，用于评估前沿VLM智能体成为机器人通才的能力，发现精确估计和可用接触定位是强项，而协调的目标导向行动仍是关键差距。
